predicted.term_length: The initial term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue for a period of five (5) years unless earlier terminated pursuant to Section 14 hereof (the "Term"). The initial term of this Agreement and any renewal term thereof shall be automatically extended at the end of the initial term and any renewal term thereof for an additional one (1) year period unless either Party notifies the other Party not less than six (6) months before the end of the then in effect term of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
termination_clauses: EITHER PARTY may terminate this Agreement (i) immediately upon written notice in the event of the closing of a Sale Transaction; or (ii) immediately upon written notice if the other files a voluntary bankruptcy petition or makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors or becomes subject to any order for relief or involuntary bankruptcy petition under any bankruptcy, liquidation, insolvency or similar law which is not dismissed within 60 days.

Qualigen may terminate this Agreement (i) upon thirty (30) days prior written notice in the event of any failure of Sekisui to make a Financing Payment that is determined to be due, which failure is not cured within such 30 day period, or (ii) upon sixty (60) days prior written notice in the event of any material breach of the diligence obligations... set forth in the Business Plan... which breach is not cured within such 60 day period.

Sekisui may terminate this Agreement upon prior written notice (i) in the event of any failure of Qualigen to meet a milestone set forth in the Development Plan... or (ii) at any other time upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice of impending termination.
predicted.governing_law: This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed and interpreted in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware, without reference to its conflicts of laws principles.
key_obligations: Qualigen hereby appoints Sekisui... as a distributor for the sale of the Products in the Territory on an exclusive basis
Sekisui shall purchase the Products exclusively from Qualigen, and Qualigen shall supply the Products exclusively to Sekisui
Qualigen shall assign to Sekisui Qualigen's agreements with Qualigen's current distributors
Qualigen shall not engage any distributors other than Sekisui for the Qualigen Retained Customers
Sekisui shall not... market, rent or sell any Products to the Qualigen Retained Customers
Qualigen shall supply Sekisui with all of Sekisui's commercial requirements for the Product in the Applicable Markets
Sekisui shall submit to Qualigen... a rolling twelve (12) month forecast of the quantity of each Product
Sekisui shall not... alter or modify... in any way any Products delivered by Qualigen hereunder
Sekisui shall not deface, cover, obscure, erase, alter or remove any Qualigen trade names, brand names, trademarks or logos
The price that Sekisui shall pay for the Reagent Kits Products shall be based upon a formula intended to ensure that Sekisui will receive 90% of the total Available Margin
Sekisui shall provide to Qualigen up to $6,200,000 of financing in accordance with the timing and other provisions of the Development Plan
Sekisui shall offer employment to four Qualigen sales representatives to become employees of Sekisui
Sekisui shall pay for each Product sold by Qualigen within 30 days after Sekisui has received the applicable invoice
Sekisui covenants to Qualigen that Sekisui will not make any false or misleading representations to customers or others regarding Qualigen or the Products
Qualigen shall maintain appropriate certification status and compliance with the FDA's Quality System Regulation
Qualigen shall notify Sekisui in writing no less than 3 months prior to any material changes which affect the form, fit or function of any Products
Sekisui will have the option to perform an audit... at Qualigen's Carlsbad, California manufacturing facility annually
Qualigen shall provide to Sekisui and its customers commercially reasonable technical support
Qualigen shall comply with applicable requirements under Regulation (EC) 1907/2006 concerning REACH
Qualigen shall own all right, title and interest in and to all Intellectual Property Rights resulting from Qualigen's activities under the Development Plan
Neither Party shall register, use or claim ownership or other rights in any logo, trade name, brand name or trademark of the other Party
Qualigen shall not... solicit, initiate, participate in discussions or negotiations... concerning a Sale Transaction during the Exclusivity Period
Sekisui shall have a right of first refusal to match the terms of any arms length, bona fide proposed Sale Transaction with a Third Party
In the event of any breach of Sections 9.1 through 9.3... Sekisui shall be entitled to liquidated damages in the amount of three times any and all Financing Payments made to date
Sekisui shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Qualigen... from and against any and all claims... arising out of the negligence or willful misconduct of Sekisui
Qualigen shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Sekisui... from and against any and all Losses incurred... related to bodily injury, death or property damage directly caused by any Product
Qualigen, at its own expense, shall procure and maintain during the Term, insurance policies with the minimum coverages set forth below
Sekisui shall be named as an additional insured with respect to the Insurance
Each Party shall keep accurate books and records... enable the other Party to determine the correctness of any report made under this Agreement
Upon reasonable written notice... the auditing Party shall have the right... to audit the books and records maintained by the audited Party
The Agreement shall not be assigned and is not assignable or delegable by either Party without the written consent of the other
Sekisui and Qualigen each may assign this Agreement without the consent of the other to a successor in connection with the merger, consolidation or sale
